PC: Assess source (Walk the cervix / Cannula test)
SBP: Observe if vital signs stable, no orthostasis, bleeding slows, and she is stable over 2 hours if suspected mild perforation.
Transfer for unstable vital signs, continued bleeding, significant suspected trauma or worsening pain or vitals after trauma.
An up-to-date chart with stabilization record should be sent to ER.
ICS: Team members should use closed-loop communications to assure clear understanding and task completion.
